g.text: Daily alarm summary - new session (Pending implementation)
Record failure only for existing task / Run
Release own slot; pause existing task if required
Recheck state, time, claim and capacity
and Run link in one transaction
CAS READY to STARTING for live owner
Persist events and root terminal state
Update existing task / Run only; release own slot
Existing history updated or cleanup only
Rejection records failure only while task / Run exist.
Duplicate acceptance returns the existing link only.
Pause after acceptance does not cancel the Run.
Whether deletion requests cancellation is not yet decided.
Deletion removes Schedule and Run; Session remains independent.
Late completion never recreates deleted Schedule or Run.
Internal coordination remains until safe cleanup.
Lost owner requires reconciliation, not replay.
